scientific_integrity: A self-contained symbolic proof is supplied. Exact finite-field code independently tests the formulas in ten cases; this is not a substitute for the all-field proof or for independent mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labelled structure matrices in dimension two over finite fields only; does not address singular matrices, moduli-uniform sampling, larger dimensions, infinitesimal schemes, or historical priority beyond inspected material.
title: Exact automorphism-group law for random two-dimensional perfect evolution algebras
